title: Character frozen mid-air for 150 frames despite continuous input
reproduction_steps: Play through the platforming level near the observed area (orange trees, floating platforms)
Enter the jump/mid-air state where the character is airborne
Continue pressing movement keys (left/right/space/up/down) as in the action_sequence
Observe that the game world and character sprite stop updating for an extended period (~150 frames) despite continued key presses
Note that pixel_diff_median (0.913) is drastically lower than clean_play_median_diff (22.924), confirming near-zero visual change
suspected_cause: Likely a soft-lock or frozen game-state bug (possibly an infinite loop, stuck animation state, or input queue desync) that halts rendering/logic updates while still accepting inputs into a buffer.
evidence_note: Compare frames 34, 75, 116, and 157: character position, enemy, coins, and background are pixel-identical across ~120 frames despite varied left/right/up/down/space inputs, indicating the game loop is not advancing despite active input.
